claim: Complementary fast episodic and slow statistical learning addresses a specificity-generalization trade-off
limitations: Biological theory has variants and does not prescribe an LLM architecture
ai_relevance: Motivates separate exact episodes and gradual semantic/procedural consolidation

claim: Emotionally arousing experiences can receive enhanced long-term consolidation
limitations: Effects depend on arousal stress timing and central versus peripheral content
ai_relevance: Motivates testing outcome-conditioned salience without claiming emotion

claim: Retrieval can make a memory labile and subject to updating under some conditions
limitations: Boundary conditions and interpretations remain contested

claim: Forgetting can reflect decay interference context change active processes or access failure
limitations: Mechanisms and their relative importance vary
ai_relevance: Engineered forgetting must distinguish archive suppression corruption and deletion

claim: Long-term agent memory is usefully decomposed into write/manage/read stages
limitations: Survey taxonomy rather than a single validated architecture
ai_relevance: Provides lifecycle structure for research and evaluation

claim: LongMemEval tests information extraction multi-session reasoning temporal reasoning knowledge updates and abstention
limitations: End-to-end QA mixes retrieval and reader effects
ai_relevance: Useful benchmark but not complete retention-utility ground truth

claim: LoCoMo provides long multi-session conversations with evidence and temporal/causal structure
limitations: Small corpus and partially generated conversations; annotation/judge details matter
ai_relevance: Useful for retrieval temporal reasoning and weak labels

claim: Continually rewriting consolidated memory with LLMs can degrade useful memories
limitations: Recent preprint and controlled task setting
ai_relevance: Supports immutable raw evidence and gated reversible consolidation

claim: Retrieval frequency alone does not establish downstream causal utility
limitations: Requires paired or causal evaluation
ai_relevance: Central requirement for learned retention labels

claim: Scrub jays can use integrated what-where-when information about cached foods with different perishability
limitations: Abstract and metadata checked; full methods and replication audit pending; behavior does not establish subjective recollection
ai_relevance: Motivates typed episodes and memory-type-specific validity horizons

claim: Cuttlefish can adjust foraging using what where and elapsed-time information
limitations: Abstract checked; narrow task family and full replication audit pending
ai_relevance: Shows similar memory function may arise in a distant neural architecture

claim: A newly learned human motor task showed time-dependent vulnerability to interference from a second task
limitations: Abstract checked; task-specific older study requiring modern replication review
ai_relevance: Motivates procedural interference and offline-stabilization benchmarks

claim: Prior loading can leave skeletal-muscle methylation signatures associated with altered response to reloading
limitations: Small cohort of eight men; association does not establish CpG causality; molecular history effect is not neural skill memory
ai_relevance: Separate retained resting state from reacquisition speed final performance and causal substrate

claim: BCG exposure can reprogram hematopoietic progenitors and change later innate immune responses in mice
limitations: Species and intervention scope; trained immunity is not antigen-specific episodic recall
ai_relevance: Motivates long-lived upstream state that changes later transient workers

claim: Recently repressed yeast genes can retain chromatin and localization state that enables faster reactivation
limitations: Specific genes and conditions; full mechanism and replication audit pending
ai_relevance: Motivates compact priming metadata and state-dependent reactivation

claim: Physarum showed stimulus-specific declining avoidance to repeated harmless exposure and spontaneous recovery after the stimulus was withheld
limitations: One organism and research group; later same-group mechanism work is not independent replication
ai_relevance: Test cue-specific reversible suppression with recovery dishabituation and rare-critical protection

claim: Acquired CRISPR spacers can confer sequence-specific phage resistance in prokaryotes
limitations: Immune defense record is not flexible cognitive memory; full spacer dynamics audit pending
ai_relevance: Motivates bounded append-like threat signatures with exact matching

claim: Individual Stentor cells changed contraction probability through a step-like stochastic transition while population-average habituation appeared gradual
limitations: Behavioral two-state model does not identify a molecular substrate; calibrated laboratory stimulation
ai_relevance: Report per-history transition distributions and heterogeneity rather than only aggregate learning curves

claim: Physarum habituation and retained sodium persisted through a one-month dormant stage and forced sodium uptake could induce the altered response
limitations: Same research group as earlier Physarum studies; retained chemical load is not symbolic content
ai_relevance: Distinguish durable response state from representational memory and test substrate ablation

claim: A partial pre-existing CRISPR spacer match primed high-frequency acquisition of additional phage-derived spacers against escape variants
limitations: Engineered E. coli; acquisition can include host-derived spacers; biological sequence machinery is not semantic retrieval
ai_relevance: Test provenance-bounded near-neighbor expansion against exact-only and unrestricted semantic expansion

claim: Elevated myonuclear density during mouse muscle hypertrophy reversed during detraining in the reported protocol
limitations: One mouse protocol; does not exclude epigenetic protein neural or behavioral savings mechanisms
ai_relevance: Reject permanent myonuclear count as a universal muscle-memory explanation

claim: Mouse myonuclear and interstitial methylation changes persisted after detraining while resting mRNA did not; previously trained muscle regrew more without a myonuclear-number difference
limitations: Mouse exercise model; persistent methylation was not causally isolated as the driver of regrowth
ai_relevance: Benchmark latent preparedness separately from persistent output and require causal ablation

claim: Yeast transcriptional reinduction after galactose priming involved gene-specific and global mRNA turnover changes in addition to known chromatin mechanisms
limitations: Short priming interval and laboratory carbon-source switch; transcriptional speed is not episodic recall
ai_relevance: Do not infer one memory substrate from one output curve; ablate derived state components independently

claim: Human BCG vaccination induced persistent transcriptional changes in bone-marrow hematopoietic progenitors linked to later myeloid response
limitations: Small invasive human cohort; broad trained immunity differs from antigen-specific adaptive memory and can have inflammatory costs
ai_relevance: Test long-lived upstream policy state separately from transient worker instances

claim: Rhesus macaque antibody output persisted for years despite sustained memory-B-cell depletion indicating separable long-lived plasma-cell and recall-reserve roles
limitations: Species and depletion intervention; persistent antibody output is not flexible recall
ai_relevance: Model active materialized cache and durable recall reserve as independently failing and rebuildable roles

claim: A stable cross-reactive mouse memory-B-cell population could dominate response to a related antigen analogue
limitations: Classic narrow antigen system; imprinting magnitude and harm are exposure- and target-dependent
ai_relevance: Make stale near-match competitive capture a primary memory benchmark stratum

claim: A habituated Physarum fused with a naive plasmodium and transferred the altered behavioral response to the merged entity
limitations: Same research program; physical fusion and cytoplasmic mixing do not transmit an inspectable proposition
ai_relevance: Collaborative memory must preserve explicit record identity provenance authorization and conflicts

claim: Human muscle proteomics after training detraining and retraining showed many reversible proteins and a smaller retained subset
limitations: Retained abundance is a potential correlate not causal proof of savings; cohort and training protocol specific
ai_relevance: Treat memory candidates as sparse retained state inside largely reversible adaptations

claim: Under matched runtime budgets decision-conflict-aware routing outperformed descriptive memory baselines overall on the reported LoCoMo experiments
limitations: Recent preprint; LLM reader/judge dependence; single-hop exceptions; runtime state budget is not disk budget; independent reproduction pending
ai_relevance: Test decision-sensitive query routing over a reversible archive

claim: A small reference experiment reported flatter fact recall for reversible archive retrieval than rolling summary overwrite across repeated compaction
limitations: Survey experiment on one small model and commodity GPU; illustrative rather than broad validation
ai_relevance: Requires a repeated-compaction curve in the project benchmark

claim: A rate-distortion population-coding model jointly fit several structured visual working-memory error patterns and was favored in seven of eight reported model-comparison rows
limitations: Restricted visual tasks; reused datasets; biological capacity/gain mechanism unresolved; N=2 monkey neural reanalysis
ai_relevance: Use consequence-weighted distortion as an evaluation lens not a deletion rule

claim: A Perspective proposes that higher-fidelity episodic retention of model-incongruent events can protect later semantic structure revision
limitations: Normative proposal synthesizing prior work; surprise is model-relative and not equivalent to emotion; full framework awaits direct testing
ai_relevance: Benchmark delayed model change rare exceptions and noise separately

claim: A generative image-memory model improved recall efficiency through semantic completion while producing plausible context-congruent errors
limitations: Simple image model; tuned attention; preprint version read; classification metrics can reward plausible but unsupported detail
ai_relevance: Keep semantic completions derived and provenance-checked

claim: A review proposes that phasic locus-coeruleus NE/DA activity can bias contextual memory from retrieval of established representations toward encoding and updating
limitations: Narrative review and extended hypothesis; timing receptor region species and chronicity produce divergent effects
ai_relevance: Test a transient update-mode controller rather than a scalar salience rank

claim: In male-mouse contextual fear conditioning longer learning intervals were associated with larger reactivated dentate-gyrus ensembles and more specific context discrimination
limitations: Task sex species and c-fos/TRAP limits; total active cells did not encode learning history; key interaction was nonsignificant
ai_relevance: Score context-specific application and overgeneralization separately

claim: A review reports that stress can shift control from hippocampal cognitive strategies toward striatal habit strategies rather than uniformly strengthening memory
limitations: Selective 2012 review; cortisol findings conflict and may depend on norepinephrine dose and task
ai_relevance: Test subsystem selection and perseveration under emotion-like metadata

claim: In two small human experiments reward enhanced delayed recollection when semantic item identity predicted reward but not when a peripheral color predicted it
limitations: Small between-group samples; no overall reward main effect; trend-level omnibus results in experiment 2; narrow reward range and RT data loss
ai_relevance: Attach consequence to task-relevant features rather than session-wide salience

claim: In a rat spatial task novelty near weak encoding rescued 24-hour memory through timing-sensitive hippocampal D1/D5 and protein-synthesis mechanisms
limitations: Male rats; small within-subject pharmacology; repeated conditions; STC is not the only possible explanation
ai_relevance: Test provisional eligibility tags followed by evidence-based promotion

claim: Experience-related rat hippocampal spike sequences recurred during later sleep and short sequences were associated with ripple states consistent with time-compressed replay
limitations: Observational; pre/post evidence from two rats; exact compression ratio not estimated; results depend on surrogate construction
ai_relevance: Test compressed replay only under matched maintenance cost and fidelity guardrails

claim: Awake rat hippocampal replay content shifted with task engagement and engaged content predicted near-term spatial choices
limitations: Eight male rats; event nesting; key engagement-by-accuracy interactions nonsignificant; causal planning and consolidation roles unproven
ai_relevance: Test separate task-local online and diverse offline replay policies

claim: Ripple-triggered disruption of hippocampal population activity causally impaired specific rat spatial-learning and memory-guided decision measures in two small studies
limitations: Small male-rat samples; one effect was moderate/transient; simple task component and later reactivation were spared; stimulation did not isolate decoded replay content
ai_relevance: Require content-targeted replay versus sham random and retrieval-only controls

claim: A small human fear study reported time- and cue-specific blockade of fear return when extinction followed reactivation by ten minutes
limitations: Behavior did not directly identify reconsolidation; selection criteria were later disputed; one-year sample was 19 with collapsed controls and one-tailed tests
ai_relevance: Use as a challenged update-window hypothesis not evidence for destructive rewriting

claim: A preregistered 124-person direct fear replication and seven sequence replications found no reliable reminder-triggered behavioral rewriting advantage
limitations: Nulls do not refute all molecular reconsolidation or every boundary condition; response systems and memory domains differ
ai_relevance: Make reads non-mutating and revisions explicit versioned and return-tested

claim: Holding encoding constant category cues recovered studied words missed by unaided recall demonstrating that non-recall need not imply loss of the stored information
limitations: Immediate categorized-word task; cues change test information; does not establish permanent traces
ai_relevance: Require direct-ID full-scan alternate-cue and oracle probes before diagnosing storage loss

claim: Selective retrieval can impair later access to related unpracticed memories but inhibition context change and competition remain rival explanations of the behavioral effect
limitations: Classic word-category paradigm; mechanism is not uniquely identified; context-account experiments challenge inhibition
ai_relevance: Test retrieval-neighbor costs with storage and write behavior held constant

claim: Temporally controlled Rac and dopamine pathway manipulations bidirectionally altered forgetting in Drosophila olfactory conditioning
limitations: Species task and circuit specific; no direct mapping to file deletion or one salience variable
ai_relevance: Treat forgetting as a controlled factorized operation and test reversibility

claim: Across seven rat experiments retrieval practice produced competition-dependent durable forgetting and medial-prefrontal silencing abolished the reported effect
limitations: Small within-animal experiments and indirect novelty measure; downstream molecular pathway untested
ai_relevance: Require a competing-task benefit and neighbor-memory cost curve before calling forgetting adaptive

claim: A 2026 Drosophila study recovered behaviorally forgotten aversive information from a silent trace using reminder and context cues while manipulated reminders could create false memory expression
limitations: Recent fly-conditioning result; behavioral and circuit recovery are not equivalent to lossless digital restoration
ai_relevance: Measure recovery integrity source identity wrong-version and false-association errors

claim: PI-LLM reported that older competing key-value updates impaired final-value retrieval across tested models even though the target remained in context and fixed-length controls preserved the trend
limitations: Synthetic task; workshop preprint; model drift; mechanistic claims exceed behavioral evidence; code issues found; independent reproduction pending
ai_relevance: Reuse a repaired deterministic generator and add historical-as-of and provenance strata

claim: WhenLoss reported a four-condition protocol that operationally separates oracle-to-complete-memory degradation from complete-to-retrieved-memory degradation
limitations: Recent preprint without located code; gaps depend on reader metric budget and gold annotations and do not prove one root cause
ai_relevance: Instrument canonical bytes index retrieval context reader and action as separate checkpoints

claim: The Nelson-Narens framework separates monitoring judgments from control actions across acquisition retention and retrieval
limitations: Organizing theory and selected experiments; not one neural module or a digital implementation
ai_relevance: Separate typed evidence monitoring from cue-search stop and abstention controls

claim: Koriat's accessibility model treats feeling of knowing as an inference from accessible correct or incorrect partial information rather than privileged access to trace strength
limitations: Three experiments in specific verbal-memory tasks; later replications and rival measures still require review
ai_relevance: Test familiar distractors partial wrong cues and false-known retrieval states

claim: Cue familiarity can affect rapid judgments of knowing independently of answer knowledge
limitations: Two arithmetic-task experiments; full paper and replication pass incomplete
ai_relevance: Never equate lexical familiarity or entity frequency with recoverability

claim: Large free-recall reanalysis and a new experiment linked search termination to elapsed search and preceding retrieval errors
limitations: Free-recall lists and behavioral termination definition; does not reveal physical trace status
ai_relevance: Log cue history progress errors and budget when stopping retrieval

claim: A computational model and human experiments support meta-level allocation of time and switching between memory searches under cost
limitations: Model abstracts object-level recall and is evaluated in constrained tasks
ai_relevance: Benchmark adaptive cue switching against fixed search and oracle action sequences

claim: Selective prediction evaluates a reject option through the trade-off between covered cases and risk on accepted predictions
limitations: Classification/regression benchmarks and trained architecture; no direct memory lifecycle claim
ai_relevance: Use risk-coverage curves rather than accuracy that hides abstentions

claim: Semantic entropy groups sampled generations by meaning and can estimate uncertainty without token probabilities in its discrete variant
limitations: Confabulation detection does not establish evidence validity storage availability or independence of samples
ai_relevance: Compare semantic disagreement with provenance and evidence-conflict signals

claim: In ambiguous-question experiments sampled answer repetition calibrated selective answering better than likelihood or self-verification baselines
limitations: Specific datasets/models; repeated outputs can share a systematic evidence failure
ai_relevance: Add common-mode consistent-wrong cases and report risk at matched coverage

claim: SQuAD 2.0 adds adversarial unanswerable questions whose passages remain relevant and contain plausible answer-like material
limitations: Extractive passage benchmark; collection and answer spans are artificially bounded
ai_relevance: Test absent targets with familiar relevant distractors and score false-sufficient decisions

claim: ASQA defines answer quality through coverage of multiple disambiguated interpretations that may require synthesis across sources
limitations: Benchmark facets are enumerated and Wikipedia-centered; real obligation discovery is harder
ai_relevance: Label query obligations separately from retrieved documents and generated claims

claim: ALCE evaluates citation correctness and citation completeness separately from response correctness
limitations: Automatic citation metrics use model and NLI components and do not establish source truth
ai_relevance: Require atomic claim-to-source links and measure both support precision and coverage

claim: ARES separates context relevance answer faithfulness and answer relevance and calibrates learned judges with a small human-labeled set
limitations: Synthetic training and learned judges remain domain and model dependent despite PPI correction

claim: RAGChecker proposes separate fine-grained diagnostics for retrieval and generation and reports stronger human correlation than compared metrics
limitations: Full metric implementation and human-correlation conditions still require audit
ai_relevance: Evaluate evidence-set recall precision claim faithfulness and hallucination separately

claim: RAGTruth provides nearly 18000 RAG responses with case-level and word-level unsupported or contradictory content annotations

claim: A multi-perspective RAG study treats hallucination and omission of required perspectives as separate detectable error types
limitations: Controversial-topic perspective task and unambiguous-error subset; transfer requires testing
ai_relevance: Score faithful-but-incomplete answers independently from unsupported claims

claim: Self-RAG learns explicit retrieve relevance support and utility reflection tokens to control retrieval and generation
limitations: Critic and generator may share model data and evidence failures; reproduction and calibration audit pending

claim: The closed-world assumption may infer a negative ground literal from failure to prove its positive form whereas open-world evaluation requires proof-supported answers

claim: Incomplete-database semantics distinguishes facts that hold across admissible completions from facts that hold in only some completions
limitations: Representation systems and tractable query classes impose formal restrictions; full theorem extraction is pending
ai_relevance: Separate certain positive evidence from merely possible answers and unsupported negatives

claim: Validity and completeness are orthogonal properties of database answers
limitations: The proposed integrity metadata does not by itself guarantee that descriptions are accurate or current
ai_relevance: Keep provenance validity and conflict checks separate from collection-coverage checks

claim: Completeness of a query answer can be characterized by independence from admissible insertion updates and can sometimes be tested for the current database state
limitations: Algorithms and complexity depend on the query and constraint language; a general personal-memory implementation is not established
ai_relevance: Generate legal counterexample insertions before accepting a negative completeness certificate

claim: Table-completeness statements can entail query completeness and weakest preconditions can identify the database fragments critical to a query in supported cases

ai_relevance: Make closure predicate entity time and namespace specific instead of global

claim: Certain-answer semantics depends on the information ordering and representation of incomplete data and is not captured adequately by one universal output construction
limitations: Abstract framework does not prescribe storage probes authorization rules or a practical agent-memory schema
ai_relevance: Treat certain answers as a safety principle while testing concrete supported query shapes

claim: Explicit completeness statements over open-world RDF sources can support sound completeness and negative-query guarantees for selected conjunctive query scopes
limitations: Restricted SPARQL fragments and declared statements do not prove source truth freshness or physical inventory coverage
ai_relevance: Attach graph closure to exact query shapes and provenance rather than treating the graph as globally closed

claim: A retrieval miss collection-bounded absence and proposition-level falsity require successively stronger evidence and must not share one not-found state
limitations: Project inference combining database theory with the existing storage-probe and sufficiency results; independently review before benchmark freeze
ai_relevance: Evaluate N0 not-retrieved N1 searched-scope N2 complete-scope and N3 explicit-falsity decisions separately

claim: QDMR is an ordered backward-referencing DAG over 13 operator families; BREAK has 83978 questions but parser exact match and manual semantic acceptance differ sharply
limitations: Grounding is outside QDMR; granularity varies; source-context splits are not semantic-template holdouts; larger graphs are excluded from GED+ subsets
ai_relevance: Use a QDMR-inspired obligation graph but score strict form structure and denotation separately

claim: RAT-SQL treats schema encoding and alignment between question mentions and schema elements as explicit components for generalization to unseen database schemas
limitations: Spider SQL task and reported leaderboard results do not establish safe memory-scope mapping
ai_relevance: Evaluate predicate namespace and relation linking separately from obligation discovery

claim: On Spider a simple parser rose from 57.4 to 72.4 dev exact match with oracle schema links; repeated manual audits attributed 29.6 percent of residual errors to exact-match false negatives and 26.3 percent to corpus errors

claim: RAT-SQL+BERT trained on Spider fell from 69.7 percent Spider dev exact match to 48.2 percent on human-curated Spider-Syn synonym substitutions

claim: COGS models scored 0.96 to 0.99 in distribution but 0.16 to 0.35 on its 21-case systematic generalization set with high seed sensitivity and worse structural than lexical transfer

ai_relevance: Hold out compound signatures while retaining familiar atoms and report each stratum across seeds

claim: CFQ DBCA keeps atom divergence low while maximizing rule-application compound divergence; three baselines dropped from above 97 percent random-split accuracy to 14.9 to 18.9 percent on MCD
limitations: Automatically generated ambiguity-avoiding English questions with anonymized entities; atom and compound definitions are design choices; thresholds do not transfer

claim: SCATE composes typed temporal entities with 18 operator signatures or variants; its initial corpus reached 0.917 span-type F1 and 0.821 full span-type-property-link F1
limitations: Only 34 initial newswire documents; rare operators and event-anchor links are difficult; no Polish or timezone-policy evidence
ai_relevance: Preserve raw span reference clock timezone operator graph normalized interval recurrence and ambiguity

claim: BLINK separates candidate retrieval from contextual reranking but assumes gold mentions have an in-KB entity and leaves NIL prediction to future work
limitations: In-KB top-1 results do not establish unknown rejection identity authorization or calibration and retrieval recall bounds reranking

claim: SemEval-2018 Task 6 evaluates SCATE graph components separately from interpreted bounded intervals and shows that better component parsing need not imply better interval results

ai_relevance: Report temporal structure exactness interval denotation ambiguity behavior and downstream certificate scope separately

claim: Structured decoding must be evaluated on schema coverage compliance efficiency and semantic task quality separately; grammar engines can be over-constrained or under-constrained

claim: A recent small-model preprint reports that hard schema decoding can increase validity while increasing wrong-valid-schema outputs; deterministic delayed packaging preserved the first-stage semantic result in its calendar control
limitations: Very recent preprint; small models and authored tasks; no memory mapping or large proprietary-model generalization
ai_relevance: Add wrong-valid-contract rate and delayed packaging control; do not treat constrained decoding as semantic safety

claim: Constrained paraphrasing into a controlled natural-language sublanguage followed by deterministic mapping is a candidate alternative to direct logical-form generation
limitations: Few-shot evaluated domains require grammar engineering and do not solve grounding NIL or safety by themselves
ai_relevance: Compare controlled obligation language with direct JSON and delayed packaging under identical gold

claim: Bidirectional table-first and column-first schema retrieval demonstrates complementary recall but retains a material false-positive rate and requires multiple model calls
limitations: Text-to-SQL BIRD and Spider only; model-dependent; similar names still fail; no NIL authorization or certificate state
ai_relevance: Score schema candidate recall FPR retained fraction calls and downstream safety before top1 selection

claim: The effect of constrained decoding varies by model adaptation task type and constraint complexity and can degrade generation even when format compliance improves
limitations: Results change direction across tasks and models and are not memory-specific
ai_relevance: Cross interface mode model class and task type rather than generalize from one provider

claim: Selective prediction minimizes risk at a chosen coverage and should be evaluated over the risk-coverage curve rather than by raw confidence alone
limitations: Classification tasks; not structured semantic parsing; softmax and dropout confidence require model access
ai_relevance: Report stage-specific selective risk coverage and AURC and distinguish model uncertainty from data unanswerability

claim: Maximum predicted probability can rank errors poorly out of domain and calibration improvements require held-out correctness supervision
limitations: NLI and duplicate-detection tasks only; learned difficulty calibrator may not transfer
ai_relevance: Do not use model probability or verbal confidence as the sole unseen-schema abstention gate

claim: NIL entity-linking examples include at least missing catalog entities and non-entity phrases and benchmark NIL labels themselves can contain material errors
limitations: Wikipedia-derived English corpus; threshold and type methods are not calibrated for local project catalogs
ai_relevance: Split NIL subtypes annotate independently and score false-link risk separately from candidate recall

claim: Incomplete-KB entity linking benefits from separating candidate retrieval from an Entity-or-NIL selector and evaluating in-KB emerging-entity and all strata
limitations: Funding domain and Wikipedia priors; small domain-specific datasets
ai_relevance: Keep local candidate generation and NIL selection as separate provider-neutral stages

claim: Emotional oddballs can improve memory for the emotional item while impairing memory for preceding neutral items; propranolol and bilateral amygdala damage abolished the coupled pattern in the reported experiments
limitations: Narrow word-oddball tasks; small pharmacological and rare-lesion samples; sex difference requires cautious treatment
ai_relevance: Score both target retention and collateral loss in temporally adjacent neutral evidence

claim: In a small randomized propranolol study arousal amplified competition between prioritized preceding items and lower-priority subsequent items rather than globally improving memory
limitations: Final N=26; salivary alpha-amylase is an indirect and contested central-NE proxy; young-adult laboratory task
ai_relevance: Cross priority and temporal position; reject session-wide scalar salience

claim: A 90-participant phase manipulation reported improved true recall when stress occurred during consolidation but impaired true recall when stress occurred before retrieval predominantly for emotional words
limitations: DRM word lists and cued recall; acute laboratory stress; phase effects do not define a universal controller
ai_relevance: Encode consolidate retrieve revise and abstain require separate control effects

claim: A 2009 human devaluation experiment reported that pre-training stress made behavior insensitive to outcome devaluation
limitations: Food-outcome devaluation task; exclusions and stress paradigm limit generality; later direct tests are not uniformly supportive
ai_relevance: Treat stress-to-procedure shift as a contested interaction not an architecture rule

claim: Two 2025 habit-goal competition experiments totaling 129 participants found no evidence that acute stress increased habit strength or decreased goal-directed control for reward or punishment avoidance
limitations: Different task and stress manipulation from the 2009 devaluation study; a null does not prove absence under every condition
ai_relevance: Require task-by-state interaction tests and a no-shift baseline; never hard-code arousal to cached procedures

claim: In rats novelty close in time converted weak inhibitory-avoidance learning into long-term memory and the effect required dorsal-hippocampal D1/D5 signaling and protein synthesis
limitations: Rat inhibitory avoidance and open-field novelty; biological molecular dependencies do not map literally to software
ai_relevance: Test expiring eligibility plus linked later promotion against immediate and global promotion

claim: When one unit's assignment can affect another unit's outcome causal analysis must distinguish direct indirect total and overall effects or otherwise define the relevant exposure mapping and estimand
limitations: Canonical examples are group-randomized vaccine experiments; a memory system needs its own defensible interference boundary
ai_relevance: Default to context-bundle treatment and require a separate identified contrast before assigning task reward to one co-exposed memory

claim: General-interference identification combines the assignment design an exposure mapping and a target estimand; dependence-aware variance alone does not define the causal effect
limitations: Exposure mappings can be misspecified and the reviewed work assumes a known interference representation
ai_relevance: Freeze assignment unit exposure mapping joint treatment versions and sensitivity analysis before T3

claim: Inverse-probability handling of censoring requires conditional exchangeability positivity and consistency; a fixed follow-up deadline does not make censoring ignorable
limitations: Identification assumptions are not fully testable and weight models can be misspecified
ai_relevance: Separate structural inapplicability missing outcome and no event by deadline; freeze diagnostics sensitivity or bounds

claim: Off-policy evaluation estimates a target policy from data generated by another policy and importance or doubly robust estimators depend on adequate logging-policy information and support
limitations: Sequential and contextual-bandit guarantees do not transfer automatically to shared-memory interference or policy drift
ai_relevance: Bind realized-action propensity to exact policy state and report overlap weights ESS clipping and multi-estimator sensitivity

claim: Direct hashes are weak pseudonymisation for low-entropy identifiers because brute-force dictionary and guesswork attacks can link them; keyed MACs or random mappings change but do not remove governance needs
limitations: Threat depends on input entropy attacker auxiliary data key custody and release context
ai_relevance: Use random opaque join IDs by default and never call user-content hashes anonymous

claim: Cryptographic operations over JSON require an invariant representation such as a named canonicalization profile if they are not explicitly defined over exact source bytes
limitations: RFC 8785 is informational and JCS is one possible profile rather than a universal mandate
ai_relevance: Record digest purpose algorithm and exact-byte or canonicalization contract including Unicode numbers key order and whitespace

claim: Data minimisation storage limitation protection by design appropriate security and erasure are lifecycle obligations that append-only integrity by itself does not satisfy
limitations: Applicability legal basis exceptions jurisdiction and exact compliance require qualified legal analysis
ai_relevance: Keep T1 locked pending an audited inventory export erasure propagation backup processor access and retention contract

claim: HippoRAG implements a graph and Personalized PageRank retrieval design motivated by hippocampal indexing and reports gains on multi-hop long-term memory tasks
limitations: The benchmark gain does not establish biological equivalence and graph construction retrieval and model effects require separate ablations
ai_relevance: Use HippoRAG as an inspectable graph/indexing comparator rather than evidence that an agent has a hippocampus

claim: ImplicitMemBench operationalizes procedural memory priming and classical conditioning through behavioral and first-decision tests and reports that no evaluated model exceeded 66 percent overall
limitations: The 300-item controlled benchmark does not by itself establish durable local memory or human-like unconscious processes
ai_relevance: Add first-action outcomes and explicit-versus-implicit dissociations to the project portfolio

claim: A 2026 study argues and experimentally illustrates that external agent memory relocates rather than removes the stability-plasticity problem because representation retrieval and experience abstraction can produce positive or negative transfer
limitations: Recent preprint; task families representations and reported transfer effects require independent reproduction
ai_relevance: Measure hard-case negative transfer and representation-specific effects instead of assuming disk storage prevents interference

claim: A 2026 survey organizes agent memory as storage reflection and experience while explicitly identifying fragmented evaluation and lack of direct quantitative comparison as limitations
limitations: A qualitative survey and evolving paper index are discovery tools rather than primary causal evidence
ai_relevance: Use its maintained index to improve coverage but route every architecture claim back to primary sources and benchmarks

claim: Memory-R1 proposes learned ADD UPDATE DELETE and NOOP operations plus memory distillation using task reward
limitations: Reward association may not identify the causal future utility of one memory and current evidence is benchmark-dependent
